hits.snippet: The round combines equity and debt and drew backing from several investors, including Peak6 founders Matt Hulsizer and Jenny Just, as well as former Sodexo US chief executive Sarosh Mistry and Condé Nast's chief product and technology officer Vasanth Williams. inKind says it has so far deployed more than $600m across various restaurant partners, ranging from larger groups and independent entities.
